recommendations.title: Reclaim inactive Cursor seats
recommendations.description: Reduce Cursor licenses by 12 seats where developers show no usage in the last 30 days.
recommendations.evidence: 21 of 52 Cursor seats are inactive (60% utilization).

recommendations.title: Downgrade Claude Opus used for repetitive automation tasks
recommendations.description: Shift Claude Opus calls in automation workflows to Claude Sonnet where complexity, output size, and ROI indicate premium model overspend.
recommendations.evidence: 30% of Claude Opus calls (171 of 515) show premium misuse signals, avg complexity 7.7, ROI 1932.4% on mismatched spend, $4,978.31 in affected premium spend, concentrated in automation workflows.

recommendations.title: Route coding GPT-4 usage to GPT-4o-mini
recommendations.description: Shift GPT-4 calls in coding workflows to GPT-4o-mini where complexity, output size, and ROI indicate premium model overspend.
recommendations.evidence: 30% of GPT-4 calls (162 of 617) show premium misuse signals, avg complexity 7.7, ROI 1576.6% on mismatched spend, $1,487.69 in affected premium spend, concentrated in coding workflows.

recommendations.title: Consolidate overlapping coding tools for Engineering
recommendations.description: Engineering uses both GitHub Copilot and Cursor for similar coding workflows. Consolidating to a single primary tool could reduce duplicated subscription and API spend.
recommendations.evidence: Engineering logged 9 active users on both GitHub Copilot and Cursor for coding workflows (100% user overlap, $630.3 overlapping spend, 98,691 vs 11,845 requests).
